bg.$description: The page's ground: paper in light, night in dark. Use var(--ds-bg). Dark: #181b1a.

surface.$description: Panels and cards; in v2, the same as the page. Use var(--ds-surface). Dark: #181b1a.

surface-sunk.$description: A sunk ground for wells, code and table stripes. Read Text 2 on it, not Text 3. Use var(--ds-surface-sunk). Dark: #232826.

text.$description: Text, headings and the interface. Use var(--ds-text). Dark: #e9ecea.

text-2.$description: Captions, notes and quiet labels. Use var(--ds-text-2). Dark: #a9b0ad.

text-3.$description: Page numbers, placeholders and step numbers. Passes 4.5:1 on paper only. Use var(--ds-text-3). Dark: #7d8582.

rule.$description: Hairlines between parts. Use var(--ds-rule). Dark: #3a403e.

rule-soft.$description: The faintest hairline: rows of a list or table. Use var(--ds-rule-soft). Dark: #2e3331.

rule-strong.$description: The strong rule: above a figure, under a running head or table header. Use var(--ds-rule-strong). Dark: #e9ecea.

field-border.$description: The border of an input, menu or text area. Use var(--ds-field-border). Dark: #7d8582.

ink.$description: The one interface accent: primary buttons, selected states, the mark. Use var(--ds-ink). Dark: #e9ecea.

on-ink.$description: Text and icons on ink. Use var(--ds-on-ink). Dark: #121413.

hover.$description: The ground under a hovered row or control. Use var(--ds-hover). Dark: #232826.

focus.$description: The focus ring. Use var(--ds-focus). Dark: #e9ecea.

ok.$description: Success and positive status: success text, a passed check. Always with a word such as "Raw". Use var(--ds-ok). Dark: #4ac26b.

warn.$description: Warning and caution status: warning text, a partial result. Always with a word such as "Templated". Use var(--ds-warn). Dark: #d9a13b.

bad.$description: Error, danger and failure: error text, error messages, a failed status. Always with a word such as "Failed". Use var(--ds-bad). Dark: #f2786d.

data-track.$description: The empty part of a bar. Use var(--ds-data-track). Dark: #232826.

display.$description: Archivo: the page's structure, headings and big numbers. Use var(--ds-font-display).

text.$description: IBM Plex Sans: the interface and running text. Use var(--ds-font-text).

mono.$value: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
mono.$description: IBM Plex Mono: what a model produced, and data. Use var(--ds-font-mono).

label.$description: Labels: the text face (IBM Plex Sans). Use var(--ds-font-label).
Labels' case: none, so labels are written in sentence case. Use var(--ds-case-label).

display.$description: Archivo's width for headings. Use var(--ds-display-stretch).

label.$description: Labels: metadata, small and gray. Use var(--ds-type-label).

small.$description: Notes and small print. Use var(--ds-type-small).

ui.$description: Controls, tables and cards. Use var(--ds-type-ui).

h2.$description: A section's heading; a slide's headline in the slideshow context. Use var(--ds-type-h2).

chrome.$description: Chrome around slides, which keeps its size in the slideshow. Use var(--ds-type-chrome).

arrow.$description: The presentation bar's arrows. Use var(--ds-type-arrow).

label.$description: Letter spacing for labels: none, now they are sentence case. Use var(--ds-tracking-label).

wordmark.$description: The spaced capitals of the full lockup. Use var(--ds-tracking-wordmark).

underlineOffset.$description: How far a link's underline sits below the text. Use var(--ds-underline-offset).

1.$description: The smallest gap: an icon and its label, rows of bars in a figure. Use var(--ds-space-1).

2.$description: Between a label and its field, and between chips in a row. Use var(--ds-space-2).

3.$description: Between controls in a row, such as buttons; inside a card. Use var(--ds-space-3).

4.$description: Between fields in a form and between cards; inside a panel. Use var(--ds-space-4).

5.$description: Within a section, and the page's sides on a phone. Use var(--ds-space-5).

6.$description: Between the parts of a centered page. Use var(--ds-space-6).

8.$description: Between a page's sections. Use var(--ds-space-8).

read.$description: Square: anything you read (the top bar, tables, figures). Use var(--ds-radius-read).

act.$description: What you act on: buttons, inputs, menus, segmented controls. Use var(--ds-radius-act).

note.$description: Round: numbered notes on a drawing. Use var(--ds-radius-note).

line-strong.$description: A strong rule; the current-item marker. Use var(--ds-line-strong).

focus-width.$description: The focus ring's width. Use var(--ds-focus-width).

focus-offset.$description: The focus ring's gap from the control. Use var(--ds-focus-offset).

control-height-sm.$description: Small controls and icon buttons. Use var(--ds-control-height-sm).

touch.$description: The smallest touch target on a phone. Use var(--ds-touch).

lockup-mark.$description: The mark in the full lockup. Use var(--ds-lockup-mark).

lockup-mark-sm.$description: The mark in the full lockup on a phone. Use var(--ds-lockup-mark-sm).

slot-status.$description: The place kept for a status line, one line tall, there before it has anything to say: min-height: var(--ds-slot-status). Use var(--ds-slot-status).

slot-hint.$description: The place kept under a control for its hint or its error, two lines tall, so an error never moves the form: min-height: var(--ds-slot-hint). Use var(--ds-slot-hint).

slot-caption.$description: The place kept for a caption that may wrap, two lines tall: the presentation bar's caption on a phone. Use var(--ds-slot-caption).

content.$description: Content, and a slide's width. Use var(--ds-content).

full.$description: The widest a page goes. Use var(--ds-full).

slide-margin.$description: A slide's side margin. Use var(--ds-slide-margin).

columns.$description: Grid columns on screens and slides. Use var(--ds-columns).

gutter.$description: The gap between grid columns. Use var(--ds-gutter).

margin.$description: The page's side margin on a screen. Use var(--ds-margin).

float.$description: Things that float over the page. Use var(--ds-layer-float).

present.$description: The slides, over the page. Use var(--ds-layer-present).

present-bar.$description: The presentation bar, over the slides. Use var(--ds-layer-present-bar).

oneColumn.$description: At this width and below: one column, the top bar's areas on a row of their own, every grid span full width. In CSS: @media (width <= 639px); a variable cannot go in a media query.

rail.$description: From this width: the list of an area's pages appears on the left. In CSS: @media (width >= 960px); a variable cannot go in a media query.

toc.$description: From this width: "On this page" appears on the right. In CSS: @media (width >= 1280px); a variable cannot go in a media query.
